hero.title: Terms of use
hero.description: Rules for lawful and responsible use of the TourLink website, its information and enquiry channels.

paragraphs.p1: The website is operated by TourLink LLC, a tour operator in Uzbekistan. The site presents TourLink destinations, services, practical information, company details and channels for enquiries.

You agree to use the website lawfully and responsibly. You must not misuse forms, submit false or harmful information, interfere with website security, copy or publish content without permission, impersonate another person or organisation, send spam or malware, or send automated requests that overload the site.

not_booking.title: An enquiry is not a confirmed booking

paragraphs.p1: Submitting a form, sending a message, discussing a route or receiving a sample programme does not create a confirmed booking. A booking exists only after written confirmation from TourLink specifying services, price, payment terms and booking conditions.

We aim to keep information about destinations, trips, services and the company useful and accurate. Travel conditions can change: route access, opening hours, borders, visas, permits, weather, transport, supplier availability, prices and safety issues.
paragraphs.p2: Information on the website is general in nature. It is not a binding travel contract, visa advice, legal or medical advice, or a guarantee of safety.

paragraphs.p1: Any route, tour idea, service description, indicative price, inclusion, exclusion or date on the website is subject to confirmation. Final terms are defined by a written proposal, invoice, booking confirmation, contract or B2B agreement.

The website, brand materials, texts, structure, design, page layouts, photographs, graphics, icons, data and other content belong to TourLink or are used under licence unless stated otherwise. You may view content for personal assessment or internal business evaluation of TourLink services, but may not use it commercially without written permission.

By submitting information to TourLink, you confirm that it is accurate to the best of your knowledge and that you have the right to provide it. If you share data about other travellers, employees, clients or partners, you are responsible for the lawfulness of that transfer.

The website may link to maps, government bodies, social platforms, messengers, supplier pages or other external services. We do not control third-party sites and are not responsible for their content, availability, security or privacy practices.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, TourLink is not liable for losses caused by relying on general website information instead of confirmed booking documents, errors in user data, third-party services, internet or hosting failures beyond our reasonable control, or events beyond our reasonable control.
These Terms are intended to be governed by the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan, unless mandatory rules of another jurisdiction apply and cannot be excluded.
We may update these Terms when the website, services, company processes or legal requirements change. The revised version will show a new update date.
For questions about this page or TourLink services, email info@tourlink.uz or use the contacts published on the website.
